tiers.title: Original-supported
tiers.description: 460 ready dossiers have original-supported text. Independent human review still checks the cited pages and the legal history.

tiers.title: Transcription-dependent
tiers.description: 324 ready dossiers rely on a disclosed provisional working text. Replace it with an original when available and recheck the quotations.

tiers.title: Confirmed working text
tiers.description: Lachmann pins the selected text and records identity, completeness and page checks. A qualifying confirmation can provisionally close the text step.

tiers.title: Lead only
tiers.description: Compiled transcriptions, catalog entries and unexamined archival replicas guide retrieval. A working-text confirmation or page examination is a separate event.

statuses.title: Provisional YES
statuses.description: 405 admitted identities have a provisional substantive YES. A complete YES claim requires a continuing legal predicate through October 14, 2026.

statuses.title: Provisional NO
statuses.description: 3,886 admitted identities have a provisional substantive NO. A complete NO claim must establish the first ending of all operative clauses and account for surviving effects.

statuses.title: No provisional status
statuses.description: 10,681 working identities lack an adopted YES or NO. A proposed status stays outside the register until authorized adoption.

statuses.title: Census candidate
statuses.description: 67 distinct Library of Congress catalog items await inclusion review. The census records 1,023 unverified Lord index appearances separately.

statuses.title: Machine exhausted
statuses.description: An applicable step can carry a documented search-to-end record. Keep its exact routes and material gap visible to the human reviewer.

statuses.title: AI-reviewed
statuses.description: An independent model examines the frozen claim and its sources. Completion requires the applicable controls, review scope and version-matched receipts.

statuses.title: Ready for human review
statuses.description: 784 dossiers meet the published tracker’s applicable requirements. Their evidence tiers and disclosed exhaustion determine what the human reviewer must inspect.

statuses.title: Human-certified
statuses.description: The published register records zero independently reviewed complete whole histories. The human reviewer’s uphold must match the exact claim hash and cover each cited source.

tasks.title: Examine the four held-actor cases
tasks.description: EO 8129, 8163, 9949 and 11026 now have source-excerpt IDs. All four remain unresolved after the retained replay.

tasks.title: Inspect the five retained PDFs
tasks.description: The recovery verified five raw hashes and 20 selected page-text hashes. No PNGs were retained, and three selected page texts are empty.
tasks.dependency: Retained PDFs, source identity and transmittal pages
tasks.next: Inspect the PDF pages directly. For EO 12095, reconcile PEB-189 with the Board 95-504 identifier before interpreting the report.

tasks.title: Replace provisional working texts
tasks.description: The tracker records 1,875 original-replacement obligations and 1,875 quotation rechecks. Obligations can survive machine readiness.
tasks.dependency: Source-ladder or archival original and a version-matched claim
tasks.next: Retrieve the original, compare its pages with the working text, and recheck each quotation.

tasks.title: Review the historical census candidates
tasks.description: The 67 distinct catalog candidates remain outside the 14,972 working identities. Date matches alone do not establish identity.
tasks.dependency: Original pages, signer, authority, duplicates and codebook inclusion review
tasks.next: Inspect the catalog item by exact LOC identity and file the research disposition for independent admission review.

tasks.title: Recheck failed claims
tasks.description: Seven provisionally classified orders carry CLAIM_CHECK_FAILED in the tracker generation. A receipt can describe a failure.
tasks.dependency: Latest claim version and its exact checker receipt
tasks.next: Inspect the per-order blocker and the failed step. Run claim-checker before readiness-tracker after a correction.

tasks.title: Hand a ready dossier to a human
tasks.description: The independent reviewer must read each cited source, test earlier cessation and savings, and identify the exact frozen claim.
tasks.dependency: Scope-complete claim, its SHA-256 and a separate independent human reviewer
tasks.next: Record the human decision and examined sources through the project’s review process. A changed claim needs a fresh review.

tasks.title: Recover the accepted population
tasks.description: Claim-kit refused 4,291 adopted rows against the former 3,403-row contract. PR 125 pinned the accepted adoption inputs and preserved the canonical status rows.
tasks.dependency: PR 119 adoption, corresponding owner ruling, independent review and holds
tasks.next: Use the newly generated packet for any subsequent scientific review.

tasks.title: Recover Cruden table lookup
tasks.description: The bounded lookup found EO 9949 in four representations of one table where ordinary number search returned zero. Related representations share the same source.
tasks.dependency: Pinned source text and the table’s introductory wording
tasks.next: Verify the cited row on the actual source page and examine legal effect separately.

tasks.title: Preserve blind-review disclosures
tasks.description: PR 129 repaired a source-note layout cue in reviewer cards. The Valla pilot materialized 139 packages and produced zero legal promotions.
tasks.dependency: Blind-review packet and semantic control adjudication
